title: plugin-auth loose end after #33268: pending-sso-users.ts header still says set-user-password admits env_native on a managed environment
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytdN5jRpgKX58AY4d

Filing gate: ① follow-up owed by landed work (merge-conflict resolution of PR #33268, #33203); p3 code-comment correction.
Blocked-by: #33268

## What is wrong

After #33268, a cloud-managed environment refuses `set-user-password` for every target, an `env_native` row and a platform administrator included. The header of `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.ts` still says an `env_native` row is what `set-user-password` admits. That holds only on an environment that is not cloud-managed.

## What lands

- Reword that header sentence so it says `set-user-password` admits an `env_native` target only off a cloud-managed environment, and that on a managed environment the door refuses everyone (#33203, ADR-0135 D5.2).
- Comment-only change; no behaviour, test or changeset needed beyond the repo's usual rules for a comment edit.

## Why

A developer who reads the header before touching the pending-person or password doors would assume a managed environment still lets an `env_native` password through, and could write a test or a door that contradicts ADR-0135 D5.2.

## Reader

The domain:server seat that next takes a plugin-auth p3; unleased (the #33059 pilot has drained).

## Duplicate check

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue pending-sso-users.ts` → 8 hits (#33187 #33181 #33785 #24762 #23166 …), none about this sentence. `"PR #33268" in:body` → 1 hit (#29908, the seat post). `loose ends in:title` → 18, none for plugin-auth after #33268.
